site.name: Syuzana Tevdoradze
site.description: Product strategy for AI and data products: test demand, price and economics before the money is spent.
hero.title: Know what's worth building — before the money is spent
hero.lead: I'm Syuzana Tevdoradze, a product lead with a technical background. I take AI and data products from strategy to launch, consult, and join teams hands-on.
hero.note: No pitch, no slides. If one conversation is enough, we stop there.
problems.title: What people come with
problems.items:
- An AI product idea — and the question of whether anyone will buy it, **before** hiring developers.
- A product in build or already live, but no clarity on what customers will pay for, or whether the economics hold once you count tokens and manual steps honestly.
- An AI feature that has "almost worked" for months. Money keeps going out; nobody decides whether to push on or stop.
- No product owner on the team: strategy, backlog and user conversations all land on the founder.
formats.title: Three ways to work
formats.audit.title: Build-or-not check
formats.audit.body: For an idea or an early product at the fork before big spending. You get a written verdict — **build / wait / rethink** — with a source behind every conclusion, and a plan for the cheapest next test. Sometimes the verdict is "don't build". That's a decision made before the money is spent.
formats.audit.inside:
- Review mining: competitors, and whatever people use today
- 5–8 interviews with your audience — including those who didn't buy
- Risk map: which assumption is the most dangerous
- One-page economics: conversion, cost per customer, cost to serve per user
formats.discovery.title: Discovery sprint
formats.discovery.duration: 4–6 weeks, through to a launch plan
formats.discovery.body: For those who've decided to build and want a tested plan, not a feature list. Everything in the check, deeper — plus positioning, a price test on real traffic, MVP scope and a 6–12-month roadmap.
formats.discovery.inside:
- Positioning: what buyers actually compare you with
- Price test: a real-price page with a stop threshold written down in advance
- MVP scope: what we cut to test the main risk
- Prioritised 6–12-month roadmap
formats.fractional.title: AI / Technical Product Lead on your team
formats.fractional.duration: 1–2 days a week; the first month is a trial
formats.fractional.body: For teams whose product is alive but has no owner. I take strategy and roadmap, weekly discovery, metrics and economics, stakeholder conversations — and help hire your permanent product lead. Fractional work done well ends with me no longer being needed.
formats.fractional.inside:
- Strategy and roadmap
- Weekly discovery and metrics
- Decision economics, including the cost of AI
- The path from prototype to production
formats.footnote: A one-off consultation (€150) and hourly work (from €100/hour) are on the [Pricing](/en/pricing) page.
process.title: How it works
process.steps:
- A free call, 20–40 minutes.
- A letter with fixed scope, timeline and price. No "let's see as we go".
- The work, with a short weekly update.
- A final session and a written report.
process.principles:
- The stop threshold is written down before we start: what counts as failure is defined in advance.
- I don't sell hours — I sell an answer to a question and the next step.
- Every conclusion is verifiable: a quote from a review, an interview recording, a number with a source and a date. If a result can't be verified, it isn't a result.
fit.title: Who it's for — and who it isn't
fit.body: Most often: founders before launch, and teams whose AI or data product doesn't add up — on money, metrics or expectations. Industry matters less than it seems: the method is the same — test demand, price and economics before code.
fit.not: I'm not the right fit if you need someone to quietly ship features from a list, or a development agency. My work is before and around development: what to build, at what price, and why.
cta.title: Want to take your product apart?
cta.body: Write to me, or book a free 20–40 minutes.

about.title: About
about.bio:
Technical product lead in AI and data products. I take a product from strategy to launch: lead the team, bring AI features to production, do the economics of decisions — including the cost of models — and cut spend where it creates no value.

My favourite part of the job is working out what's worth building before the money is spent.
